turns.q: For a first-timer like me, what's the safest, easiest choice?
turns.replyTail:
easiest choice?
The safest, easiest choice for a beginner is the Snake Plant.
It is extremely sturdy and forgiving. It tolerates low to bright indirect light, dry air, and prefers to dry out between waterings, meaning it forgives an occasional forgotten watering.

turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
use it properly the very first time?
menu
To use your tool set properly the very first time, start with the hand rake and spade to gently loosen and prep the soil in your pot.
When watering, use a gentle mister or watering can to water thoroughly around the base until liquid trickles from the drainage holes, avoiding the plant's center crown. Afterwards, use the pruning shears to clean up any dead or damaged leaf tips.
